blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Converge ICT Solutions Inc. still expects its revenues to grow this year despite soaring inflation and other economic headwinds slowing subscriber growth, particularly among lower-income households. As of the third quarter, the Dennis Uy-led fiber provider’s subscriber base had grown to just 3.1 million from 3.09 million at the start of the […]...
